reviews.title: Warning - you cannot cancel their subscription
reviews.text: This app charges you after a 7 day free trial and then makes it impossible for you to cancel the subscription. The subscription does not appear in your phone subscription’s section, in your Apple account , and when you contact them they say they can’t help you. I had to call my bank to get it cancelled and charged back

reviews.title: Be careful!
reviews.text: When you use this free scanner, be very careful. When you open the app, it starts with an advert. Once you navigate that, the scanner appears. When you scan the QR code, it doesn’t take you to the where you want to go. The initial link takes you somewhere else. Some of these links are scammers and fraudulent “subscription traps (as called by my bank’s fraud team).” You have to close the initial link to access your link.

reviews.title: Shady purchasing practice
reviews.text:
I see I am not the only one this happened to so it shows me we are being ripped off by “trying out” this App. I NEVER pay $12.50 for an App. Much less one that does so little. My camera can do this without an App so why would I buy this? I didn’t, yet I was charged $12.50 for a month!! If I had to scan the inventory at Walmart I couldn’t justify this cost. Don’t expect Apple to help you with this either. I contacted the day I was charged for this to say I didn’t mean to purchase but they didn’t even care.
WARNING BEWARE OF THUS SHADY PRACTICE OF FORCING A PURCHASE WITHOUT ANY CONFIRMATION OF THE CHARGE AND NO REFUNDS OR CANCELLATIONS REVEN FOR MISTAKES.
